package.summary:
Apt is a runtime and pipeline for conversion and playback of Adobe Flash files.
This package is a cross-platform library which provides a bytecode interpreter, garbage collection, and other low-level interfaces. Games need to provide an implementation layer on top of this package, typically called an "AptAux" layer, specific to their title's chosen rendering technology, asset format, and so on.
